$comment: Which forknets exist, and where each one is in its life. index.html reads this to build the tab strip; tools/build.py reads it to decide what to generate. A network's displayed state is derived from its dates, so betanet turns LIVE on its launch date and alphanet turns retired on its sunset date without anyone editing this file that morning. See 'The network lifecycle' in README.md before changing root_network.

networks.name: Alphanet
networks.summary: The first eCash forknet. Being retired five days after the betanet release.
networks.notice: Alphanet is going away. Move your hashrate to betanet — blocks found here after the sunset date are on a chain nobody is following, and the pools below will stop answering.

networks.name: Betanet
networks.summary: The second forknet, and where alphanet miners go. Retired in turn once mainnet is up.
networks.notice: Listings are open now. Open your pull request before launch day and your pool is on this page the moment betanet opens.

networks.name: Mainnet
networks.summary: The one that stays. Roughly two weeks after betanet — early October 2026.
networks.launch_note: Expected early October 2026, about two weeks after betanet.
networks.notice: Not open yet, and the launch date is not fixed. You can still open a listing PR — nothing goes live until the date is set here.
